Position: Consultant - Education
Employment type: Fixed Term Contract
Location: Bangalore/Mumbai
About Sattva
We Partner to deliver social impact at scale
Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale.
We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory & orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships.
Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in 
About the Team
Foundation team’s core objective is to be strategic advisors to domestic and global foundations to achieve orbit shifting impact. Our focus is on enabling holistic organisation and ecosystem transformation - by rigorously solving problems, formulating strategic solutions which are logically sound and effective on the ground and ensuring all stakeholders are effectively engaged and their interests are covered.
The Opportunity
As a Consultant in the Foundations team, you will be an integral part of a team that designs and builds solutions that best address our clients’ needs and create measurable impact. As a Consultant, you will get an opportunity to work alongside individuals/teams on research, design, delivery, ecosystem engagement and business growth.
Key responsibilities
Project Management
-- Independently build simple project plans and manage daily responsibilities efficiently.
-- Actively track project milestones and manage multiple streams within the project to ensure execution as per timelines.
-- Possess excellent time management and prioritisation skills to work on key activities directly linked to impact outcomes.
-- Proactively identify and report project-related risks, mitigating them in consultation with the project lead.
-- Maintain comprehensive documentation of key project knowledge assets, ensuring all critical information is well-documented and easily accessible.
Stakeholder Engagement
-- Build credibility and influence with the middle management of client organisations, relevant stakeholders in the education ecosystem through proactive engagement and demonstrated experience.
-- Actively engage with clients, comprehending both articulated and unarticulated needs.
-- Articulate your perspective by leveraging pertinent information, compelling arguments, and illustrative examples.
Team Collaboration
-- Work with junior team members, guide Associate or Analysts on the team to achieve high-quality project deliverables on time; Able to give and receive constructive feedback to the team members in a respectable manner.
-- Collaborate with senior stakeholders of the organisation, actively contributing innovative ideas and frameworks as needed to support business growth initiatives.
-- Manage conflict within the team in an open and transparent manner.
Strategic Thinking & Problem solving
-- Stay updated on trends in the education ecosystem and actively build perspectives, frameworks, and mental models that strengthen strategic thinking.
-- Structure problem statements and support the development of evidence-backed, contextually grounded strategic recommendations.
-- Understand the broader vision of the organisation/project and align workstreams accordingly.
-- Take a step back periodically to identify emerging insights or patterns that may influence project work.
Research & Data Analysis
-- Lead primary and secondary research (proficiency in literature review, market research, solution landscape mapping , policy research, etc.).
-- Prepare interview questions for primary research, manage focus groups, carry out interviews and conduct surveys.
-- Conduct relevant quantitative/qualitative analysis on the data to cull out meaningful insights relevant to client problems.
-- Present data insights in a concise and meaningful manner using relevant visualisations.
Key qualifications and experiences:
-- 4–6 years of experience in consulting, project management, operations, research in the corporate sector, social sector, or global foundations.
-- MBA or an equivalent postgraduate degree in business management, development studies, public policy, education, or social sciences.
-- Prior experience in the education sector including experience with education programs, research, evaluations, policy analysis, or similar work.
-- Experience working with government school systems, state education departments, or education-focused foundations/NGOs is required.
-- Prior experience in a client- or customer-facing role is preferred.
-- Experience in leading small teams and contributing to program strategy is an added advantage.
-- Willingness to work closely with field teams and travel to project sites as required.
-- Proficiency in regional languages (Odiya/Hindi/Kannada) is an added advantage.
-- Demonstrate humility, willingness to listen, and eagerness to learn.
We cultivate a supportive and inclusive work environment for all our employees and reinforce diversity in our workplace. All applications regardless of race, religion, caste, color, place of origin, gender, sexuality, disability, and age will be welcome and will be fairly evaluated as per the requirements of the role.
Why Sattva?
It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.
-- Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design
-- Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment
-- Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can
-- Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow
How to Prepare?
This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. Our work is combined with research and insights that draw on forty years of proprietary data and experience, giving our teams the evidence and clarity to support complex business decisions and to shape what comes next. Since 1985 we have grown to 400+ professionals across 17 offices in 13 countries, and our experts have delivered work in more than 140 countries. Our vision is to be the leading authority and catalyst for digital change, connectivity and inclusion. We help businesses, governments and investors use technology to create a world that is more connected, competitive, sustainable and secure. Our London Transformation team is scaling quickly, building out their capabilities across technology intensive sectors that complement Analysys Mason’s award-winning transaction-advisory offerings, positioning us as the global consulting partner of choice across the entire transact-to-transform lifecycle for our clients.

Job Description
Scaling our Commercial Excellence offering across technology intensive sectors is a crucial part of our growth strategy, as we aim to provide clients with comprehensive access to our full range of expert capabilities. As a Senior Consultant, you will play a key part in contributing to Analysys Mason’s global growth. You will work alongside our Commercial Excellence lead and a highly motivated team responsible for the growth of the practice, shaping and mentoring your career. You will work on complex and strategic projects for clients, partnering with them throughout the entire lifecycle. Acting as a bridge between Analysys Mason and our clients, you will support the delivery of value-led outcomes that meet our clients’ high standards and expectations. Our projects are diverse, and your focus could include pricing strategy, monetisation, revenue growth management, sales effectiveness, commercial operating model working alongside corporate and PE clients. You will also play a significant role in the coaching and mentoring of internal and client teams. Our culture is highly collaborative and team-oriented, and our people enjoy a hybrid work model, balancing client proximity, the convenience of remote work, while enjoying team spirit through work in our offices. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Delivering a wide variety of international commercial excellence and transformation projects across technology intensive industries. Taking ownership of key project workstreams, from analysis through to recommendations. Engaging directly with client stakeholders on your workstream, presenting findings and helping clients address complex commercial challenges. Producing high-quality analysis and deliverables, and supporting the day-to-day development of junior colleagues. Contributing to thought leadership and intellectual capital in specialist topic areas, helping bring new insight to our clients. Supporting proposals, client meetings and business development activities to drive the continued growth of the practice.

Qualifications
We recognise and celebrate the fact that not everybody is the same, and we value the diversity of backgrounds and skillsets you will add to our team. Senior Consultants are critical members of our project teams, having a clear impact on the company growth and the development of our team of experts. This role is ideal for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit, seeking autonomy and the chance to make an impact on a growing team, on leading clients and on the market. This is why, as a minimum, you need: consulting experience delivering commercial excellence engagements for high-profile clients across technology intensive sectors such as TMT, Utilities, Industrials, Space and Satellite, Transport & Mobility, B2B Software or Consumer Tech project experience within pricing strategy, monetisation, revenue growth management, sales effectiveness or commercial operating model.

Job Description
Our early careers opportunities have a strong record of establishing early career foundations and developing well-rounded industry skills in our Associate Consultants. You will work on a diverse mix of international projects with the best-known brands in the industry, applying our deep domain expertise and methodology to solve complex business issues. You will attend our comprehensive training programme where you will learn essential consulting skills and industry knowledge through courses, networking and teamwork. After completing the training, you will join project teams and provide strategic advice and high-quality analysis on all aspects of strategy planning, transaction support, regulation and policy while continuing your professional development. Because our project teams are small, you will regularly get direct exposure to our world-class experts, not only in your office, but also across our global locations. You will receive hands-on mentoring from experienced members of the team, including our Partners. Qualifications
